boundaries: Software CI only: no QEMU/physical USB/driver recovery/secure USB end-to-end claim. Separate kernel-socketpair QEMU failure is not a failure of this exact software CI.
304 is test executions per matrix cell (108 default +176 all-features +20 vendor), not unique cases. Eighteen transport tests run twice per cell.
292 is the harness-selected frozen file set; it can include evidence source files and is not the number of compiled source files. Exact Git blob hashes were independently checked.

Raw job logs and run ZIPs are archived and cross-checked byte-for-byte. Individual signal artifact payloads and runner ELF binaries were not uploaded by this workflow; their receipts and hashes are observed in the printed summary, not independently downloaded bytes.
Blocked stdout cases prove wait0 and data EOF without draining the blocked pipe; they do not provide a stopped resource snapshot.

The release binary provenance is tied to exact check.sh build order, API step success and per-case /proc executable device/inode/hash receipts. No assertion that the standalone transport crate is linked into the CLI.
Pages status/check logs are verified for exact commit. Artifact byte contents and current public site were not fetched in this task.

Reviewer correction: the initial parser incorrectly required the exact wchan pipe_write; Ubuntu24.04 kernel6.17 logs use anon_pipe_write. Initial four parser failures and parser are preserved. The corrected exact accepted set matches observed kernel names and the already-frozen harness suffix rule; no CI result or runtime evidence was changed.

No repository changes, workflow reruns, builds or QEMU were performed by reviewer. GitHub connector used for jobs/logs; read-only gh REST supplemented full run/job metadata and original ZIP logs because wrappers omit those fields/formats.
